# ProtectedMulticall
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/ProtectedMulticall.sol)

**Inherits:**
Context

**Title:**
ProtectedMulticall

Provides a function to batch together multiple calls in a single external call, recording
the original caller in transient storage so nested calls can be gated to the multicall flow

Provides a function to batch together multiple calls in a single external call.
Consider any assumption about calldata validation performed by the sender may be violated if it's not especially
careful about sending transactions invoking [multicall](/src/contracts/ProtectedMulticall.sol/abstract.ProtectedMulticall.md#multicall). For example, a relay address that filters function
selectors won't filter calls nested within a [multicall](/src/contracts/ProtectedMulticall.sol/abstract.ProtectedMulticall.md#multicall) operation.
NOTE: Since 5.0.1 and 4.9.4, this contract identifies non-canonical contexts (i.e. `msg.sender` is not {_msgSender}).
If a non-canonical context is identified, the following self `delegatecall` appends the last bytes of `msg.data`
to the subcall. This makes it safe to use with {ERC2771Context}. Contexts that don't affect the resolution of
{_msgSender} are not propagated to subcalls.


## State Variables
### CALLER_KEY

```solidity
bytes32 constant CALLER_KEY = keccak256("admirals-quarters-caller")
```


## Functions
### onlyMulticall

Restricts a function to be called only within an active multicall by the recorded caller


```solidity
modifier onlyMulticall() ;
```

### multicall

Receives and executes a batch of function calls on this contract

Reverts with MulticallAlreadyInProgress if a multicall is already active. Records the
caller in transient storage for the duration of the batch.

**Note:**
oz-upgrades-unsafe-allow-reachable: delegatecall


```solidity
function multicall(bytes[] calldata data) external payable returns (bytes[] memory results);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`data`|`bytes[]`|The encoded function calls to execute against this contract|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`results`|`bytes[]`|The return data of each executed call|


### _multicall

Executes a batch of delegatecalls against this contract, propagating the ERC-2771
context suffix to each subcall when in a non-canonical context


```solidity
function _multicall(bytes[] calldata data) internal returns (bytes[] memory results);
```

### _setCaller

Records the original multicall caller in transient storage


```solidity
function _setCaller(address caller) internal;
```

### _getCaller

Returns the original multicall caller from transient storage (zero when inactive)


```solidity
function _getCaller() internal view returns (address);
```
